description: Every user-facing sentence the app shows for a Core state, error, limitation or notice, keyed by the contract's closed vocabularies. Plain words; no code names, paths, stack traces or source content. The completeness test fails if the contract gains a value this file lacks.

task_states.verified: Checked the answer against your sources.
task_states.partially_completed: Done, with limits you should read.

errors.invalid_request: Atlas did not understand that request.
errors.unsupported_version: This app and Atlas speak different versions. Update the app or Atlas.
errors.unauthenticated: This device is not recognised by Atlas.
errors.forbidden: This device is not allowed to do that.
errors.conflict: That cannot be done right now.
errors.source_denied: Atlas is not allowed to search that kind of source.
errors.task_expired: The task ran out of time. You can ask again.
errors.task_failed: The task could not be finished. You can ask again.
errors.needs_attention: The task was interrupted. Please ask again.
errors.model_unavailable: The local model is not available right now. Atlas never sends your questions elsewhere. Check that the model drive is connected and try again.
errors.citation_failed: The answer could not be checked against your sources, so Atlas is not showing it.
errors.timeout: That took too long. You can try again.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong inside Atlas. Nothing was sent anywhere. You can try again.
errors.os_access_missing: macOS has not given Atlas access to that folder or app. Allow it in System Settings, then ask again.
errors.index_unavailable: Atlas is still preparing that source. Try again in a moment.

terminal_reasons.partial: Finished, but not everything could be checked.
terminal_reasons.expired: Stopped because it took too long.
terminal_reasons.citation_failed: Not shown, because it could not be checked.
terminal_reasons.model_unavailable: The local model was not available.
terminal_reasons.denied: Nothing was searched: Atlas is not allowed to search those sources.

verification.verified: Every citation was checked against the source, and every figure and date appears in the cited text.
verification.partially_verified: Some of this is checked against your sources; read the notes below.
verification.unverified: This is not checked against a source. Treat it as unconfirmed.
verification.failed: A citation did not hold up, so Atlas is not showing the answer.

limitations.source_type_not_searched: Some kinds of source were not searched (see below).
limitations.language_unmeasured: Atlas has not yet measured how well it handles this language; check the answer yourself.
limitations.language_unsupported: Atlas cannot reliably handle this language yet.
limitations.low_confidence: Atlas is not confident about the language of this question.
limitations.figures_unproven: Some numbers in the answer do not appear in the cited text.
limitations.dates_unproven: Some dates in the answer do not appear in the cited text.
limitations.context_truncated: There was more material than fitted; the answer used only part of it.
limitations.partial_work: Not everything could be searched; the answer may be incomplete.
limitations.answer_withheld: The answer is hidden because permission to a source it used was withdrawn.
limitations.task_stopped_no_answer: The task stopped because permission to a source changed. There is no answer.
limitations.sensitive_items_excluded: Some items were left out because they are more sensitive than your permission covers.
limitations.indexing_incomplete: Atlas is still reading your sources, so it may have missed some.
limitations.source_unsupported: Some files are of a kind Atlas cannot read yet.
limitations.os_access_missing: macOS has not allowed Atlas to read some of your sources.
limitations.attachment_pending: Some attachments are still waiting to be read.

coverage_state.complete: Searched everything that is in scope.
coverage_state.partial: Searched part of what is in scope.
coverage_state.indexing: Still reading your sources; results may be incomplete.

coverage_pending.unsupported_source: in a format Atlas cannot read

not_searched_reasons.no_grant: You have not allowed Atlas to search this.
not_searched_reasons.grant_expired: Your permission for this has expired.
not_searched_reasons.sensitivity_exceeds_grant: This is more sensitive than your permission covers.
not_searched_reasons.restricted_domain: This kind of data needs its own permission.
not_searched_reasons.unknown_source_type: Atlas does not know this kind of source.

model_line: Answered on this Mac by {model_id} ({role}). Nothing left your computer.
model_line_unknown: Answered on this Mac. Nothing left your computer.

locator_kinds.header_field: the {header} line (as the sender wrote it)
